bio: Within her staff, Plumia incubates the Crystal Egg - a curious gem that will hatch into a phoenix "whose flames will ignite the land anew". Plumia is the egg's 32nd, thoroughly unwilling, custodian. She's been doing everything to make sure the egg doesn't hatch, as she reckons its grand emergence involves the Emerald Kingdom burning down. Let the next poor custodian deal with that mess.
